text.text:
I found Robert on YouTube at the beginning of 2024 while searching for an effective and affordable way to market my business. Only two years into my real estate career, I had left a brokerage that gave its agents access to Boomtown and hoped to recreate that stream of leads. I also didn't like that when I left that brokerage, my website stayed with the brokerage.

I found myself watching video after video of Robert's and started to see that what he was saying, while time-consuming and not "cheap," was the way to go. I'm now 16 months into my contract with Robert and his team, and despite what folks are saying about 2025, I’ve had my best year in real estate.

In terms of specifics, as I look at the sources of this year’s GCI, my Google Business Profile and the ads we’ve run around specific properties account for about 50% of this year’s business.  It’s interesting, I started out thinking I'd just have to go back to Boomtown, bite the bullet, and pay for it as a solo agent. By working with Robert and his team (Aubrey and Jed are very responsive and professional), I've essentially created Boomtown results without the cost, and I own my website. The startup costs were a bit higher; building a website is time-consuming and complicated. However, my investment has paid for itself and thrown off revenue to boot.

When Robert and I spoke for the first time, he pointed out that I fell outside his typical process—I made the choice to commit without having to be sold. Part of that is because, like me, Robert is a sober person, and that detail (and the fact that he shares that in his process) got my attention. I took his advice on that front as well and have leaned into who I am, freely telling colleagues and clients my story. Now, a portion of my income each year goes to my favorite sober charity on the Cape; some of my clients joined me, making donations of their own.

I couldn't recommend Robert and his team at Inbound REM more if you want to get real results and build something lasting. Thank you, Robert!
